title: "Recipe directory"
---

One page indexing every recipe: theme section, level, tools used.
Level counts are hand-counted until the directory generator lands
(the [directory + Top-10 views lane](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-book/issues/10)),
then they regenerate from the recipe headers at build time and this
page becomes a generated artifact — never hand-counted again.

## Top-10 collections (generated views, planned)

Per the organisation ADR, Top-10 collections render as build-time
generated index pages over recipe tags — recipes never move between
sections. Planned sets: OWASP LLM Top-10 (the garak recipe already
carries `llm01`; mappings per manifest row), OWASP ML Top-10, OWASP
API Top-10. No collection page renders until its tagged recipes
exist — never an empty view.
